title: Storyboard, Script & Panel Sequence Binding
objective: Represent storyboard page/panel sequence, scene and beat notes, cast presence and dialogue/script references as SAA bindings without replacing or mutating CSW, Adventure, Story, Character, Dialogue or Scene identity/truth.
acceptance: Storyboard state preserves stable SAA project/page/panel identity and explicit deterministic page/panel sequence rather than inferring narrative order from coordinates.
Scene and beat notes are presentation/planning references linked to existing owner-domain identities and do not become replacement Adventure/Story/Scene truth.
Cast-presence entries reference existing Character/NPC/Creature actor or owner identities rather than copying canonical character state.
Dialogue/script entries preserve external dialogue/script reference identity plus readable display/reference state without silently rewriting authored dialogue or narrative truth.
Missing, stale or incompatible scene/beat/cast/dialogue references remain explicit and fail closed rather than fabricating owner-domain content.
Keyboard/textual equivalents can inspect and edit storyboard sequence/binding metadata without requiring drag gestures.
Provider-off local operation is supported for locally available governed references; optional AI and paid cloud are not required.
SAA-12 and later lettering/export/share/publication/SMB10B behavior remain unauthorized.
boundaries: CSW/Adventure/Story retain canonical story, adventure, scene/beat and narrative identity; Character/NPC/Creature retain canonical cast identity/state; Dialogue owners retain canonical dialogue/script truth.
SAA-11 stores storyboard sequence and reference bindings only and may not silently create, rewrite or replace owner-domain truth.
No automatic semantic rewriting, story generation, dialogue generation, export/share/publication or final Creator integration authority is granted.
SAA-12 remains blocked until verified SAA-11 closeout.
next_action: Establish causal RED for explicit deterministic storyboard page/panel sequence plus fail-closed scene/beat, cast-presence and dialogue/script owner-reference bindings with keyboard/textual editing; then implement only SAA-11.

last_material_progress.evidence: Owner Continue governed-started SAA-11 after verified SAA-10 closeout.
